verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native integration that sends Fellow notes into Slack channels, Notion pages, or Zapier. The only Slack evidence covers recording Slack Huddles, which captures meetings rather than delivering notes. The REST API and webhooks are developer building blocks a team could use to build such flows, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier
